data.one_liner: A Material 3 expressive loading indicator widget for Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides an indeterminate loading indicator that follows Material 3 expressive design. Allows custom colors, size constraints, and polygon shapes via material_new_shapes.
use_when: You need a Material 3‑styled loading spinner
You want easy customization of color, size, and shape
avoid_when: You require a determinate progress indicator
You need extensive animation control beyond the provided shapes
strengths: Customizable color, size, and polygon shapes
weaknesses: Only indeterminate mode, no determinate support
Limited to shapes provided by material_new_shapes
Relies on an additional shape package
data.setup_notes: Add expressive_loading_indicator and material_new_shapes to pubspec and import them.

alternatives.name: animations
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides a collection of ready‑made loading animations without extra shape dependencies
